sourceText: Fig. 2 reports the EER computed using test embeddings extracted from overlapped speech segments containing less than 1.6​s1.6\,\mathrm{s} of non-overlapped target speech. Enrollment embeddings are extracted from segments with at least 1.6​s1.6\,\mathrm{s} of non-overlapped target speech. This evaluation measures the ability of the embedding extractor to associate challenging overlapped speech with the corresponding clean speaker representation. As expected, speaker-activity conditioning provides the largest improvements on datasets with higher overlap ratios. However, these gains do not translate proportionally to DER, since the downstream EEND-VC pipeline is also affected by inaccuracies in the local DiariZen speaker-activity estimates.
